blocks.text: VALENCIA CITY, Bukidnon, Philippines — A man died after allegedly leaping off the towering Atugan Bridge in Impasugong, Bukidnon, on Monday afternoon, Nov. 16, adding to a troubling string of fatal plunges and near-misses at one of Mindanao’s highest bridges. The tragedy took place between 3 p.m. and 4 p.m. under clear skies at the 223.04-meter bridge in Barangay La Fortuna, a vital Sayre Highway artery linking Northern Mindanao to the Davao Region. Responding personnel from the Impasug-ong Municipal Police Station (MPS) already established the male victim’s identity, though authorities withheld his name pending formal notification to the family.
